mapper.select: SELECT h.history_id AS historyId, h.user_id AS userId, h.order_id AS orderId, h.stock_code AS stockCode, h.bias_type AS biasType, h.message_detail AS messageDetail, h.time, h.is_read AS isRead, s.stock_name AS stockName, o.transaction_type AS transactionType, o.quantity AS quantity, o.order_price AS orderPrice, (o.quantity * o.order_price) AS totalAmount FROM history h LEFT JOIN stock_order o ON h.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN stock s ON h.stock_code = s.stock_code WHERE h.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY h.time DESC

SELECT h.history_id AS historyId, h.user_id AS userId, h.order_id AS orderId, h.stock_code AS stockCode, h.bias_type AS biasType, h.message_detail AS messageDetail, h.time, h.is_read AS isRead, s.stock_name AS stockName, o.transaction_type AS transactionType, o.quantity AS quantity, o.order_price AS orderPrice, (o.quantity * o.order_price) AS totalAmount FROM history h LEFT JOIN stock_order o ON h.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN stock s ON h.stock_code = s.stock_code WHERE h.user_id = #{userId} AND h.time >= CONCAT(#{startDate}, ' 00:00:00') AND h.time <= CONCAT(#{endDate}, ' 23:59:59') ORDER BY h.time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO history ( user_id, order_id, stock_code, bias_type, message_detail, time, is_read ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{orderId}, #{stockCode}, #{biasType}, #{messageDetail}, NOW(), #{isRead} )
mapper.select: SELECT history_id AS historyId, user_id AS userId, stock_code AS stockCode, bias_type AS biasType, time FROM history WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND stock_code = #{stockCode} AND bias_type = #{biasType} ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1
